requirements.title: ACOSH argument restrictions
requirements.definition: X shall be of type real or complex.

pending.acosh-argument-admissible: Future positive controls call ACOSH with admissible argument types and values from p3. Invalid type or out-of-domain source shapes remain source-control only and carry no local diagnostic expectation because p3 is an unnumbered argument restriction.

requirements.title: ACOSH result characteristics match X
requirements.definition: The ACOSH result has the same characteristics as X.

requirements.title: ACOSH mathematical approximation is processor dependent
requirements.source: 16.9.6 p5 approximation clause; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF377.
requirements.definition: The ACOSH result value is a processor-dependent approximation to the inverse hyperbolic cosine function.

pending.acosh-processor-dependent-approximation: No portable oracle may require a particular rounded floating result for the approximation. Future tests may assert only source-fixed bounds or exact characteristics, not exact transcendent values.

requirements.title: ACOSH result range constraints
requirements.source: 16.9.6 p5 range clause; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF377.
requirements.definition: The result is constrained by the real or complex-part ranges stated in p5.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9 and 16.9.1-16.9.7: ABS, ACHAR, ACOS, ACOSD, ACOSH and ACOSPI (batch179). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer, accepted with no findings. ACHAR's required results for codes 0-127 are split from the processor-dependent cases, and the exact result ranges of the inverse cosine family are split from their processor-dependent approximations; Examples are informative. Source accounting only.
